items.name: Agallamn na Senorach

items.description: Chunk of odd metal found in some Gnoll caves.

items.description: A key found after a skirmish near Ryn.
items.name: Silverband Key

items.description: An emblem worn by senior members of the enigmatic Silverband.
items.name: Silverband Emblem

items.description: A precious stone given in thanks to the Knockers by their Selkies for their timely aid.
items.name: Knocker Ruby

items.description: A blade of impressive workmanship which seems designed for the purpose of dispatching reptilians.
items.name: Bane of the Saur

items.description: Llawereint 'The Silver Handed', God of Rivers, created these for his wizard followers. Makes the wearer as supple and graceful as a winding river.
items.name: Llawereint's Hands

items.name: Tinner's Cap

items.description: Blessed by the unearthly power of the Third Rune. This shield grants superb protection to its owner.
items.name: Rune Shield

items.description: Forged by Kynyaf to allow passage on the Runic ferry.
items.name: Forged Ferry Ticket

items.description: A gift from the frost giant deity Ymir to his devotees. Its special purpose is to destroy fire based creatures.
items.name: Short Sword of Ymir + 3

items.name: Horn of the Wild Hunt

items.description: Fir'bolg relic supposedly linking the ancient Fir'bolg settlements.
items.name: White Rose

items.description: Found in the Stronghold of the Seven.
items.name: Bag of Skulls

items.description: A Tathlum is an ancient weapon. The head of a close blood relative of an enemy is taken and dipped in lime. Of devastating force when thrown only at that particular enemy.
items.name: Tathlum

items.description: Strange piece of twisted metal found northwest of the Runic City.
items.name: Small Piece of Metal

items.description: Found by Palthus on a distant campaign along the Runic empire's eastern frontier.
items.name: Sentinel's Quiver

items.description: Mighty hammer used for tunnel excavation by tin miners. Also a handy weapon.
items.name: Miner's Maul

items.description: Teague had this helm designed to overcome his foes who employed sound based weaponry. Totally defeans the wearer.
items.name: Teague's Helm of Silence

items.description: Mighty spear of the long dead Fir'bolg hero, Cu Culainn, the Hound of the Host.
items.name: Gae Bolga + 3

items.description: A lit candle made of human fat is required to cast the necromantic spell 'Summon Shade'.
items.name: Lamp of Human Fat

items.description: Cerredwhen was a great healer who was blessed by this powerful relic for his good deeds by the God Dagda.
items.name: Cerredwhen's Cauldron

items.description: Gwyddno was a reckless but inventive Fir'bolg wizard. He crafted this ring to provide him with protection during his many long voyages.
items.name: Ring of Gwyddno

items.description: Grappling hook found in the Praetor's private quarters in the prefecture of New Caster.
items.name: Grappling Hook

items.description: Magical thread. Perhaps something wondrous could be spun from it if the right loom were found?
items.name: Fey Thread

items.description: Manannan, the Sealord, occassionally throws his hand into the fray by granting the use of powerful artifacts.
items.name: Manannan's Favour

items.description: A giant sized barrel of rum. Strong enough to keep a frost giant warm in the fiercest of weather.
items.name: Barrel of Rum

items.description: A shield imbued with the magical power of the legendery Ossian, Bard-Protector of the Tuatha de Danaan.
items.name: Ossian's Shieldsong

items.description: Wine of high quality
items.name: Runic Wine

items.description: The bestial gnolls of the Grey Mountains in the frozen north are fine craftsmen of shields and armour.
items.name: Gnoll War Shield

items.description: Battle staff imbued with the dread power of the Grey God.
items.name: Grey Staff

items.description: Orcs swear that their patron deity, Gruumsh, first handed this fell weapon to Murbad the Tainted to honour his destruction of the valley Sidhe.
items.name: Gruumsh's Cleaver

items.description: A cavalry lance. A charging bonus is granted if on horseback. Otherwise acts like a polearm.
items.name: Battle Lance

items.description: Standard issue to the elite fighting unit known as the Runic Dragonriders.
items.name: Dragonriders Shield

items.description: A mighty lance capable of delivering fiery destruction to its victims.
items.name: Flaming Lance + 4

items.description: Worn by those corrupted by the Grey God.
items.name: Pendant of the Grey God

items.description: A great songspell sung by Ossian the Lyrist. The cream of the Danaan warriors sacrificed their lives to allow Ossian to sing this songspell and prevent the Grey God's manifestation.
items.name: Lay of Victory

items.description: A long spear with wicked barbs along the shaft. It is designed to cause grievous wounds upon being ripped free from the flesh of the victim.
items.name: Craisech

items.description: Brightly coloured trousers commonly worn by the men of Karnak.
items.name: Bracae

items.description: Cernunnos, a creation of pure Chaos, uses this shield to aid him in his senseless slaughter of wild animals.
items.name: Chaos Shield

items.description: A vicious whip formed from the thorns of black roses.
items.name: Twine of Thorns

items.description: Forged by the Shadow Dwarves of the demonic plane of Gehenna for their liege lords the Glooms.
items.name: Demon's Scythe

items.description: An artifact created by an Alder Ent of the Boscawen Copse from his own wooden body. It commerorates the Battle of the Trees 'Cad Goddeu'.
items.name: Belt of Cad Goddeu

items.description: A cruel corruption of the Druid's sickle used to trim undergrowth. The sickle is coated in a deadly poison form the sap of the Hemlock tree.
items.name: Poisoned Sickle

items.description: A savage weapon wielded to great effect by the mindless Deoc Garde.
items.name: Dread Axe

items.description: A book of heresies depicting rites designed to summon a horrific entity referred to only as the 'The Nameless One'.
items.name: Prophecy of the Nameless One

items.description: The battle standard of a Runic Legion boosts morale and empowers the Legionnaires who stand beneath it.
items.name: Runic Battle Standard

items.description: Mighiest weapon of the Tuatha de Danaan, a race of deadly archers. Arianhrod was a skilled ranger who was known to enjoy the kill more than her peers thought natural.
items.name: Arianrhod's Seeker +5

items.description: Founded of black steel in the forges of the Shadowguant's dark homeland. Wielded by the mighty Shadowgaunt champion known as the Executioner.
items.name: Cri de Guerre

items.description: Ossian of the Danaan, reputed to be the greatest Bard in history, sang some of his life essence into this Torc prior to his final battle with the Shadowgaunt and their master.
items.name: Torc of Ossian

items.description: Bathed in spells of ruin and madness - to peer upon its unholy image causes even the stoutest of heart to think only of flight and of imminent death.
items.name: Middneaht Shield

items.description: In the hands of an Assassin this vicious blade grants powers of stealth and deadly grace. Rumoured to have been crafted by the Crocodile Dancers of Hupe.
items.name: Assassin's Blade + 3

items.description: Gremyr's personal weapon of choice.
items.name: Mace of Annointing

items.description: Vicious blade employed by the Quicklings. In the hands of another, a dreadful curse.
items.name: Quickling's Blade

items.description: Founded of black steel in the forges of the Shadowguant's dark homeland. Wielded by the Jedda of the Shadowgaunt himself.
items.name: Mercy Killing

items.description: This ring imparts much forbidden lore concerning the sluagh, an ancient term for the undead. Its possession aids in the destruction of these unnatural beings.
items.name: Ring of the Sluagh

items.description: The Sword Archon is the fiercest nemesis of the demon. They are merciless in their destruction of these nether beings. This ring provides but a fraction of their power.
items.name: Ring of the Sword Archon

items.description: A malicious trap desiged by the fey Quicklings. Their motives remain impenetrable.
items.name: Cursed Torc of the Quicklings

items.description: When first the Skalds of the northern fasts met the Bards of this land much musical lore was exchanged. Greatest perhaps of the Skald's gifts was the secret of this instrument.

items.description: Semius, young son of the Praetor of New Caster.
items.name: Semius, a Runic Child

items.description: Belief in the Eighth Rune is considered blasphemy in the Runic Empire. A persecuted cult of believers is thought to exist.
items.name: Mask of the Eighth Rune

items.description: First used by Balor, a mighty Fororian King in his battles against the Boneshavers. Blessed by Domnu, the patron Goddess of the Fomors.
items.name: Fomorian Hammer

items.description: Guireterax. A stallion brought at great expense from the heart of the Runic Empire.
items.name: Prize Stallion

items.description: Grrrr...
items.name: Captured Boggart

items.description: A bag full of body parts found in a recently unearthed grave.
items.name: Buried Remains

items.description: The essence of the lich Clur'can resides in this amulet.
items.name: Phylactery of Clur'can

items.description: Named in honour of the mighty Valkyrie Herfjuttor.
items.name: Herfjottur's Ring

items.description: The Boar is the symbol of Independence. Teague wore this shield proudly in days of yore.
items.name: The Boar's Head

items.description: Pauldron, mighty Priest-Warrior of Arn, wielded this mighty mace in battles long forgotten.
items.name: Pauldron's Smiter + 3

items.description: Sabaton, Battle Mage of the Fir'bolg settlement of Murias, employed this shield to great acclaim in defence of his city.
items.name: Sabaton's Bladeturner

items.description: Emblazoned with the symbol of the Runic Light Horse. Shield designed for use on horseback. Lighter and curved to allow the rider free movement.
items.name: Runic Light Horse Shield

items.description: Animating device used to control a Dweomer Golem. A useful defensive simulcram for mages to defend key positions against other spell-users.
items.name: Dweomer Golem Statue

items.description: 'Druid's Knot' Made from sprigs  of the sacred trees of ash, oak and yew. Worn around the belt. The bonds of faith bind both ways.
items.name: Snaidm Druad

items.description: 'Druid's Fence' A cloak made from the leaves and bark of the sacred trees of ash, oak and yew. The bonds of faith bind both ways.
items.name: Airbe Druad

items.description: 'Drink of Forgetfulness'
items.name: Deog Dermaid

items.description: A ring to tie the wearer to another. Aids in the ability to resist charms and the attentions of others.
items.name: Cladagh Ring

items.description: Shroud of swirling energy worn as a cloak. Capable of reflecting magic directed against the wearer.
items.name: Shroud of Rainbow Winds

items.description: Smeared with woad, a powdered paste which calls the attention of the Gods of War to the wearer.
items.name: Armour of Bersark

items.description: Will summon a Urisk war party to your aid. Use sparingly, as it can be used but thrice.
items.name: Pipes of the Urisk

items.description: Maybe the Quicklings aren't so bad after all ... to leave a gift behind in this way.
items.name: Quickling's Gift
